objective: iFile message-filing feature for mobile and desktop. Add an 'iFile' command that is the first button available when an email is opened. Clicking it opens a dialog container with a search textbox. While the textbox is blank, the result list contains no search results. As the user types, folder-tree leaf matches (wildcard-capable) are prepended to the list. The dialog container must be built to also receive classifier results and recent choices as future input sources (those sources are deferred / not yet built). Selecting a result moves the message to that Outlook folder and saves any attachments to a OneDrive directory; the root 'Archive' Outlook folder maps to a OneDrive 'Archive' folder, and target subfolders are created on OneDrive to mirror the Outlook folder structure.
change_budget_estimate: Large path / full-feature. Cross-cutting: manifest (button + dialog runtime, desktop + mobile form factors), Office.js dialog command wiring, host-neutral folder-tree wildcard search/match logic, Graph mail-folder enumeration + message move adapter, OneDrive (Graph drive) attachment-mirroring adapter, dialog UI page (HTML/CSS/TS). 4+ production surfaces. Requires research, spec, user-story, atomic planning, atomic execution, feature review.

resolved_decisions.OD-7: Server-side order is attachments-first, move-last: (1) resolve/create mirrored OneDrive folder, (2) upload attachments, (3) move message. Any earlier failure leaves the message in place and reports a clear error; retries are safe.
resolved_decisions.OD-10: Tier T2 for the filing command + Graph adapter (a misfile is recoverable, not silent data loss). Host-neutral pure modules (wildcard matcher, path mapping, result composition) still require >=1 property-based test per pure function.
resolved_decisions.OD-4: Save all non-inline file attachments; skip inline body-embedded content.
resolved_decisions.OD-5: Archive root in the mailbox is identified by the mail folder displayName 'Archive' under the mailbox root, NOT the Graph well-known 'archive' mailbox.
resolved_decisions.OD-6: CHANGED FROM DEFAULT: the OneDrive Archive root is not auto-named. On first use (no stored mapping) the user picks an existing OneDrive folder OR creates a new one to serve as the Archive root. The Outlook-Archive -> OneDrive-folder mapping then PERSISTS in user settings and is reused without re-prompting. Subfolders beneath the mapped root are still create-if-missing to mirror the Outlook structure.
resolved_decisions.OD-8: NAA primary token acquisition; fall back to backend on-behalf-of via getAccessTokenAsync SSO. All privileged operations stay server-side.
resolved_decisions.OD-9: Deterministic search ordering: exact/prefix matches first, then alphabetical by full folder path. Search results are prepended ahead of future classifier/recent sources.

research_key_findings.hard_constraint_mobile_dialog: Office Dialog API (displayDialogAsync) is NOT supported on Outlook mobile (iOS/Android). On desktop the iFile UI opens as a real dialog; on mobile the same search UI must render inline in the full-screen task pane. messageChild requires Mailbox 1.9.
research_key_findings.hard_constraint_attachment_content: getAttachmentContentAsync requires Mailbox 1.8 (not on mobile); item.attachments metadata (Mailbox 1.1) is available everywhere. Fetch attachment content server-side via Graph.
research_key_findings.hard_constraint_convert_id: On Outlook iOS item.itemId is already REST-formatted and convertToRestId is unsupported; branch on platform.
research_key_findings.architecture_split: Per No-COM rule 8, folder enumeration + message move (Graph POST /me/messages/{id}/move) + attachment fetch + OneDrive mirroring (Graph drive API) execute SERVER-SIDE in a new TaskMaster.Application command + TaskMaster.Infrastructure adapter, behind the existing OBO/NAA token flow. Client posts message REST id + destination folder id.
research_key_findings.pure_modules: Host-neutral testable TypeScript: wildcard matcher (glob * and ?, case-insensitive, NFC, escape \* \?, empty=>no results, match leaf name and full path), multi-source result-list composition (classifier+recent+search ordering; empty sources allowed), Outlook->OneDrive path mapping under Archive root.
research_key_findings.manifest_scope_changes: manifest.json add MailboxItem.ReadWrite.User; manifest.xml ReadItem->ReadWriteMailbox; AAD delegated scopes add Mail.ReadWrite, Files.ReadWrite, Mail.ReadBasic; extend validDomains/AppDomains for prod host.
research_key_findings.command_action: Use ShowTaskpane action pointing at the iFile page as the first control in the message-read group/surface (ExecuteFunction not documented on MobileMessageReadCommandSurface). iFile must be the first controls[] entry (desktop) and first <Control> (mobile).
